scope: Source-disjoint sampled FineWeb claim pairs. Paired arms swap assigned speakers and change the source-specific recap phrase. Each target is the first BPE token of the selected noun chunk; full CE includes the rest of text. This is a semi-parametric DGP, not an exact all-token oracle.
duplicate_screen: Exact source hash and SimHash Hamming<=3 across splits.
caveat: Raw source and generated prose remain in the local cache. The selected phrase is one of several valid noun chunks; speaker-swap response, candidate rank, full-vocabulary prediction, and form are distinct evidence.
